name: Update project context
description: Update existing context files based on new decisions, changes, or learnings from workflow runs.
whenToUse: After completing a design debate, feature delivery, or when project facts have changed.

team.perspective: Propose context updates based on recent decisions or changes.
Verify proposed updates don't contradict existing facts, check for staleness.
Apply verified updates to context files, maintain coherence.

texts.update-rules:
## Context Update Rules

**Allowed updates:**
- Add new verified facts to `facts/`
- Add new decisions to `decisions/` with full rationale
- Move resolved issues from `open_issues/` to `decisions/`
- Update `perspectives/` based on new learnings
- Supersede old decisions with new ones (use `supersedes` field)

**Forbidden:**
- Deleting facts without explicit user approval
- Changing decisions without recording the superseding decision
- Writing unverified content to `facts/` (use `working/` first)

**Staleness detection:**
- Check `invalidatedBy` conditions on existing decisions
- Flag decisions that may be stale based on new information
- Mark stale decisions with `status: stale` in their header

**Keep the knowledge true and small (every create and update):**
- Verify each claim against the repository and cite where it lives: the file and the symbol (function, type, constant), never a line number (lines move).
- Check every citation before you propose, approve or write it: `ls <path>` for each path, `grep -n <symbol> <file>` for each symbol, and quote what you ran; then read enough of the cited code to confirm what you say it does — existence is not meaning. A citation nobody checked is not verified (past runs approved two paths that do not exist and a test described as checking something it does not).
- Never copy volatile numbers (counts of tests, files, lines or entries; sizes): point to the source that holds them.
- Prefer a pointer to a source (file, ADR, decision) over a copy of it. One file per topic: update it, never create a second one.
- Write module paths from the repository root (`src/...`), so a reader can open them.
- A fact states what is true now. Work that is not built yet belongs in a decision (with its status) or in `open_issues/`.
- An update replaces stale text instead of appending history (git keeps the history); the knowledge base grows only when something new is recorded.
- Set `updated:` to today's date in the header of every file you create or change.
texts.changelist-format:
## Change-list format (context-changes.json)

The artifact MUST be a single JSON object applied by `dw apply <runId>`:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "changes": [
    { "op": "delete", "path": "open_issues/resolved-issue.md" },
    { "op": "create", "path": "decisions/my-decision.md", "content": "---\ntype: decision\nstatus: active\ndate: YYYY-MM-DD\nupdated: YYYY-MM-DD\nsource: commit:<sha>\nconfidence: verified\nscope: shared\n---\n\n# Decision Title\n..." },
    { "op": "update", "path": "facts/pattern-x.md", "content": "---\ntype: fact\n...full file content..." }
  ]
}
```

**Rules:**
- `op`: create | update | delete
- `path`: relative to .claude/context/, starts with facts/ perspectives/ decisions/ open_issues/ working/, ends in .md
- `content`: REQUIRED for create/update (full file incl. YAML header), FORBIDDEN for delete
- The YAML header `type:` must match the folder: facts→fact, decisions→decision, open_issues→open_issue, perspectives→perspective, working→working
- `dw apply` validates paths + headers, writes atomically, and verifies with SHA-256. Any violation aborts the whole apply.

phases.title: Identify needed updates
phases.goal: Proposer analyzes the brief and recent changes to identify what context needs updating.
instructions: Read the current context files in .claude/context/
Compare with the brief's new information
List proposed additions, modifications, or supersessions
For each update, state the source (which decision/change triggers it)
Identify any facts that may now be stale

phases.title: Verify proposed updates
phases.goal: Debate whether proposed updates are valid, don't contradict existing facts, and are properly sourced.
instructions: Check for contradictions with existing facts
Reject any update that breaks a rule of text:update-rules (an unverified claim, a line number, a copied count, a path not written from the repository root, a second file on a topic)
Agree on final list of updates to apply

phases.title: Build the change-list
phases.goal: Writer produces a deterministic change-list artifact that 'dw apply' writes to .claude/context/. Do NOT write files directly — emit the change-list only.
instructions: Emit the artifact as a SINGLE JSON object matching text:changelist-format exactly — no markdown, no prose outside the JSON
Each verified update becomes one entry in changes[] with op create|update|delete
create/update entries carry full file content including the YAML header (type, source, confidence, scope, updated)
delete entries carry only op and path (for resolved open_issues)
paths are relative to .claude/context/ and start with facts/, perspectives/, decisions/, open_issues/, or working/
Do NOT write any file yourself — the change-list is the only deliverable; 'dw apply <runId>' performs the writes with verification
Reviewers: approve only when every entry keeps the rules of text:update-rules; each broken rule is a major issue

triggers: Proposed update contradicts a verified fact
User input needed to resolve conflicting information
